package settings

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/json"
	"sort"
)

func Render(settings map[string]string) ([]byte, error) {
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(settings))
	for key := range settings {
		keys = append(keys, key)
	}
	sort.Sort(sort.Reverse(sort.StringSlice(keys)))

	var rendered bytes.Buffer
	rendered.WriteByte('{')
	for index, key := range keys {
		if index != 0 {
			rendered.WriteByte(',')
		}
		encodedKey, err := json.Marshal(key)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		encodedValue, err := json.Marshal(settings[key])
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		rendered.Write(encodedKey)
		rendered.WriteByte(':')
		rendered.Write(encodedValue)
	}
	rendered.WriteByte('}')
	return rendered.Bytes(), nil
}
